data.body: AC amendment: Defend text plumbing — DD3 requires the LLM classification to produce defense argument text for defend-classified comments. The current --classify-as CID:defend flag causes _handle_defend to use 'Design decision defended: ${comment_body}'. The skill MUST write the LLM-generated defense argument text back to the comment's 'body' field in the TMP_OUTPUT JSON before calling --classify-as CID:defend, so the defend handler uses the real LLM text. Document this JSON-body-overwrite approach in SKILL.md.
